name: Windbound Execution
description:
Select 1 Skill for Varka. At the start of the next Round, remove 1 die, switch to Varka, and prepare the corresponding Skill:
Deal 6 Anemo DMG.
Or:
Apply the corresponding Elemental Infusion based on the elements attached to your characters. Then perform 2 Normal Attacks.
